facebook.content:
Family — We stand on the promise that the house of God is a house of peace.  
Father, we declare Your righteousness to reign over every home. Let love, unity, and divine provision flow like a river through each household. Break every spirit of division; raise up godly leaders who walk in Your truth.  

If you stand with this, drop a 🙏. Share your own prayer need below.

Drop a 🙏 if you stand in agreement, or share your own prayer request below.
